items.zh: 这房子一个月房租多少？水电全包吗？
items.scene: 刚加中介微信，先问问价钱

answers.en: How much is the rent a month? Are utilities included?
answers.note: 最常用的问法，两件事一次问清，适合微信上第一次询价。

answers.en: What's the monthly rent? Does that cover utilities, or are they extra?
answers.note: or are they extra 把话挑明，怕中介含糊带过，语气比第一句更较真。

answers.en: So what am I looking at a month, all in?
answers.note: all in 指打包总价，口气随意，熟人介绍房东时用不显生分。

items.zh: 房租能商量吗？我打算一签两年。
items.scene: 看房时当面和房东谈价

answers.en: Is there any wiggle room on the rent? I'm looking to sign for two years.
answers.note: wiggle room 是还价的常用说法，先探口风，不把话说死。

answers.en: Could you come down a bit? I'd sign a two-year lease.
answers.note: 直接要求降价，把长租当筹码，适合已经看过房、有意向的时候。

answers.en: Would a two-year lease get me a better rate?
answers.note: 不问能不能降，改问长租有没有优惠，给房东留面子，谈价不那么僵。

items.zh: 房租每月几号交？微信转账行吗？
items.scene: 签合同前确认付款方式

answers.en: When's rent due? Can I just send it to you on WeChat?
answers.note: 口语问法，due 指到期日，on WeChat 指微信转账，最日常的说法。

answers.en: What's the payment date each month? Is a WeChat transfer okay?
answers.note: 措辞更完整，适合跟年长的房东确认细节，不容易有歧义。

answers.en: Rent's due on the first, right? I can send it over on WeChat.
answers.note: 带着自己的猜测去核实，房东只需点头，比开放式提问省事。

items.zh: 押金多久能退？搬走当天退吗？
items.scene: 签合同前把退款条款问明白

answers.en: When do I get the deposit back? On the day I move out?
answers.note: 中性问法，把最常见的退押时间点摆出来让对方确认。

answers.en: How soon after I move out is the deposit refunded?
answers.note: how soon 问的是天数，适合预计房东会拖几天的情况。

answers.en: The deposit comes back the day I hand over the keys, right?
answers.note: 把交钥匙这个动作点出来，等于要求当场结清，态度比前两句硬。

items.zh: 墙上就几个钉子眼，也要扣押金？
items.scene: 退租验房，房东指着墙面

answers.en: You're really going to dock my deposit over a few nail holes?
answers.note: 反问句，带不服气，适合房东明显在挑刺的时候。

answers.en: Do those nail holes come out of the deposit?
answers.note: 只确认扣不扣钱，语气平稳，还没到争执的地步。

answers.en: That's just normal wear and tear — you can't charge me for that.
answers.note: wear and tear 指正常使用损耗，直接摆合同道理，适合条款写明时。

items.zh: 中介费怎么收？能少收点吗？
items.scene: 中介带看前先谈费用

answers.en: What's your fee? Is there any room to negotiate?
answers.note: 先问标准再问余地，留了台阶，适合还没定下哪套房时。

answers.en: How much is the agency fee? Can you do anything on the price?
answers.note: do anything on the price 是委婉砍价，比直接说 discount 柔和。

answers.en: So it's one month's rent, right? Any chance you could go lower?
answers.note: 先说出行业惯例再要求减，暗示你知道行情，底气更足。

items.zh: 你发的这几套都在我预算内吗？
items.scene: 中介微信连发十几套房源图

answers.en: Are all of these actually within my budget?
answers.note: actually 带点怀疑，暗示前面发来的有超预算的。

answers.en: These all fit what I told you I can pay, right?
answers.note: 把之前说过的预算抬出来，提醒对方别再发超标的房源。

answers.en: None of these are over budget, I hope?
answers.note: I hope 语气偏软，像在开玩笑，适合不想把中介得罪的时候。

items.zh: 能先看房再谈中介费吗？
items.scene: 中介催着先交定金再看房

answers.en: Can I see the place first before we talk about your fee?
answers.note: 把顺序摆清楚，先看房后谈钱，语气客气但不让步。

answers.en: I'd rather look at the apartment before we get into the fee.
answers.note: I'd rather 表明自己的偏好，比 can I 更坚持，适合对方一直在催。

answers.en: Let's not talk money until I've actually seen it, okay?
answers.note: 用 let's 拉近距离但划了线，okay 收尾像在商量，实际是拒绝。

items.zh: 这房子是合租还是整租？现在住几个人？
items.scene: 房源描述没写清，打电话问

answers.en: Is this a shared apartment or the whole place? How many people live there now?
answers.note: 合租和整租两个词并列问，对方不用猜你想租哪种。

answers.en: Am I renting a room or the whole apartment? How many roommates are there?
answers.note: 从租客角度问，renting a room 比 shared 更直白，适合电话里确认。

answers.en: So is it shared? And how many people am I living with?
answers.note: 口语里只用 shared 一个词，后半句换成 living with，听起来更随意。

items.zh: 水电燃气费怎么分摊？
items.scene: 看合租房时问里面住的租客

answers.en: How do you split the utilities?
answers.note: split 是最常用的分摊说法，简洁，适合随口一问。

answers.en: How are the utility bills divided between roommates?
answers.note: divided between 说得更完整，适合第一次见面、需要说得清楚些。

answers.en: Do we split everything evenly, or does each room pay its own?
answers.note: 把均摊和按房间算两种方案都提出来，逼对方给出明确规则。

items.zh: 现在室友是男生还是女生？
items.scene: 女生看房前先问清同住的人

answers.en: Are the roommates guys or girls?
answers.note: 最直白的问法，熟人之间或语音里常这么说。

answers.en: Who else is living there — any guys?
answers.note: 先问还有谁住，再单独问有没有男生，关注点更明确。

answers.en: Is it a mixed place, or all women?
answers.note: mixed 指男女混住，一次问清整间房的构成，适合谨慎的人。

items.zh: 今晚七点能过去看房吗？
items.scene: 下班后想顺路看房，发消息给房东

answers.en: Can I come by and see it around seven tonight?
answers.note: come by 是顺路过来的意思，轻松自然，适合微信约时间。

answers.en: Would seven tonight work for a viewing?
answers.note: work for 是问对方方不方便，比 can I 更客气，适合第一次联系。

answers.en: I get off work at six — can I swing by at seven?
answers.note: 先说下班时间再约，显得安排得过来，swing by 比 come by 更随意。

items.zh: 这房子朝南吗？下午有太阳吗？
items.scene: 看房时站客厅盯着窗户

answers.en: Does it face south? Do you get sun in the afternoon?
answers.note: 最直接的问法，问朝向也问采光，租房时最常听到。

answers.en: Which way does it face? Is there any afternoon sun?
answers.note: 先问朝向再说采光，适合不确定是不是朝南、想听房东描述的情况。

answers.en: It's south-facing, right? How much sun does it get?
answers.note: 自己先猜再让对方确认，how much 追问阳光够不够，比是或否更细。

items.zh: 晚上能听见马路上的车声吗？
items.scene: 看房时特意关窗听了一会儿

answers.en: Can you hear the traffic at night?
answers.note: 最简洁的问法，问的是实际感受，适合站在窗边随口问。

answers.en: Is it noisy at night, or pretty quiet?
answers.note: 把两种可能都摆出来，房东不好含糊其辞，答案更具体。

answers.en: How bad is the road noise with the windows closed?
answers.note: how bad 预设了有噪音，追问关窗后还剩多少，适合临街的房子。

items.zh: 合同能先发我看看吗？我想读一遍。
items.scene: 签之前让中介把电子版发来

answers.en: Can you send me the lease first? I want to read it through.
answers.note: read it through 指从头读到尾，说明不是随便扫一眼。

answers.en: Could I get a copy of the contract before I sign?
answers.note: 更书面的说法，适合正式发邮件或跟中介公司沟通。

answers.en: Send the lease over, would you? I don't sign anything I haven't read.
answers.note: 祈使句加 would you，态度不客气，适合对方急着让你签字时。

items.zh: 要是工作调动，中途能转租吗？
items.scene: 担心被派去外地，提前问转租

answers.en: If I get transferred, can I sublet the place?
answers.note: sublet 是转租的标准说法，直接问条款，适合看合同前确认。

answers.en: What happens if I have to move for work? Is subletting allowed?
answers.note: 先讲情境再问规则，房东更容易给出具体答复。

answers.en: Say I leave in six months — can I find someone to take over?
answers.note: take over 是找人接手，口语化，适合跟私人房东聊，不像在抠合同。

items.zh: 家具家电都配齐了吗？有洗衣机吗？
items.scene: 看房时打开柜子挨个检查

answers.en: Is it furnished? Is there a washing machine?
answers.note: furnished 问是否带家具，简短直接，适合边看边问。

answers.en: Does the rent include furniture and appliances — like a washer?
answers.note: 问的是租金里含不含这些，避免入住后另收钱，适合签约前确认。

answers.en: Everything comes with the place, right? Washer, fridge, the works?
answers.note: the works 指一整套，列举几样再打包问，语气轻松但问得很全。

items.zh: 这沙发太旧了，能换一个吗？
items.scene: 看房时指着客厅的旧沙发

answers.en: This couch is pretty worn — could it be replaced?
answers.note: worn 指用旧了，先说事实再提要求，语气不冲。

answers.en: Any chance of a new sofa before I move in?
answers.note: any chance 是委婉请求，把时间点定在入住前，方便房东安排。

answers.en: I'd want that sofa swapped out. Is that doable?
answers.note: 直接说自己的条件，is that doable 又留了余地，适合已经决定要租时。

items.zh: 从这儿走到地铁站要多久？
items.scene: 看完房出来掐表走去地铁

answers.en: How long's the walk to the subway from here?
answers.note: 最常用的问法，直接问步行时间，适合看房路上随口问中介。

answers.en: How far is the subway station on foot?
answers.note: 问的是距离不是时间，on foot 强调走路，适合想自己算时间的人。

answers.en: Walkable to the subway, or do I need a bike?
answers.note: walkable 是能走着去，后半句给出替代方案，问法轻松带点幽默。

items.zh: 早上上班高峰打车好打吗？
items.scene: 担心通勤，问楼下便利店老板

answers.en: Is it easy to get a cab here in the morning rush?
answers.note: cab 是美式口语里的出租车，问的是高峰期好不好拦。

answers.en: Can you actually get a car on the app in the morning, or is it a nightmare?
answers.note: car on the app 指在打车软件上叫车，nightmare 是夸张说法，适合和年轻人聊。

answers.en: How's the morning rush for taxis around here?
answers.note: how's ... for taxis 是评价式问法，请对方给个整体印象，不限于某一天。

items.zh: 室友作息怎么样？晚上会带朋友回来吗？
items.scene: 看合租房时问已经住着的女生

answers.en: What are the roommates' schedules like? Do they have people over at night?
answers.note: schedules 指作息，have people over 指带人回家，两句都偏口语。

answers.en: Are they early birds or night owls? And any late-night guests?
answers.note: 用 early bird 和 night owl 对比，问得生动，适合气氛轻松时。

answers.en: Do the roommates keep normal hours? Any visitors after ten?
answers.note: normal hours 暗含对作息的期待，after ten 给出具体界限，问得更实际。

items.zh: 公共区域谁打扫？室友爱干净吗？
items.scene: 看房时看见水池里堆着碗

answers.en: Who cleans the common areas? Are the roommates tidy?
answers.note: 直接问分工和习惯，中性，适合第一次看房时了解情况。

answers.en: Is there a cleaning schedule, or does everyone just pitch in?
answers.note: pitch in 指大家一起搭把手，问有没有制度，暗示你在意这事。

answers.en: Who's on dish duty around here? The kitchen's a mess.
answers.note: 指着眼前的碗发问，带点调侃，适合气氛已经比较熟的时候。

items.zh: 我周末偶尔做饭，室友会介意吗？
items.scene: 自己爱下厨，看房时先问清楚

answers.en: I cook on weekends sometimes — would that bother anyone?
answers.note: 先说自己习惯再问会不会打扰，最稳妥的问法。

answers.en: Is it okay if I use the kitchen on weekends?
answers.note: 直接请求许可，语气更客气，适合对方看起来比较讲究。

answers.en: Would the roommates mind me cooking now and then?
answers.note: now and then 表示偶尔，比 sometimes 更轻，强调不会天天占厨房。

items.zh: 搬家公司怎么收费？能帮忙拆床吗？
items.scene: 打电话问搬家报价和拆装

answers.en: How much do movers charge? Can they take the bed apart?
answers.note: movers 指搬家工人，问价和拆床分开问，最清楚。

answers.en: What's the rate for moving? Do you handle disassembly?
answers.note: rate 更偏报价单的说法，disassembly 书面，适合跟公司客服谈。

answers.en: What am I looking at for the move? Can you guys take the bed apart?
answers.note: looking at 问大概花多少钱，take apart 是拆开，跟师傅直接说最自然。

items.zh: 周六上午能来吗？东西不多，一车够吧？
items.scene: 和搬家公司约时间，报了行李数量

answers.en: Can you come Saturday morning? It's not much — one truck should do it, right?
answers.note: one truck should do it 是估计一车够，先报量再让对方确认。

answers.en: Are you free Saturday morning? I don't have much, so one load should cover it.
answers.note: one load 指一趟，比 one truck 更强调来回次数，适合东西零散时。

answers.en: Does Saturday morning work? Just a few boxes and a bed — think one trip's enough?
answers.note: 先把东西列出来再问，方便师傅判断，think 结尾是口语化的征询。
